new.start_new: Fill in the form for a new person

new.already_applied: This person already has an application in this project.

new.sent: Application number: {appNo}. The office will check it and let you know.
new.sent_no_number: The application has reached the office, which will check it and let you know.

list.title: My applications
list.empty: No applications in this list yet.
list.load_failed: The applications could not be loaded. Try again.
list.no_project: You are not on any project yet. Once you join one, your applications show here.

detail.title: Application
detail.sent: The application has been sent to the office.
detail.load_failed: The application could not be loaded. Try again.
detail.action_failed: That could not be done. Try again.
detail.stale: The application has changed meanwhile. Reload it.

office.title: Applications
office.search: Search by name or application number
office.empty: No applications in this project yet.

dialog.return_to_review: Return the rejection to await approval

done.waitlist: The application is on the waitlist.
done.pull_from_waitlist: The application is approved from the waitlist.
done.verify_link: The entry is linked to the profile; the application is now submitted.
done.verify_create: A new profile is created; the application is now submitted.

office.stale: The application changed meanwhile. Reload it to see the latest.

decision.message_help: This is what the volunteer and the team member read.
decision.who_reads: The office's reason never reaches the volunteer.
decision.comment_help: The comment stays in the audit log, read by the officials only.

why.against_score: Why does this decision go against the score order?
why.quota_full: The quota of this area is full. Why approve anyway?
why.family_match: Someone from the same family is in this project. Why approve anyway?

flag.public_entry: An entry from the public link; verify it and link it to a profile, or refuse it.
flag.late_sync: Taken on a phone before the deadline and sent after it; check it and verify.
flag.stale_form_version: Taken on a phone with an older version of the form; check whether the new questions matter.
flag.existing_identity: A profile with this number already exists.
flag.identity_blocked: The profile with this number is blocklisted.
flag.identity_repeated: The same number or mobile came through this link again within a day.
flag.blocked_name_match: The name, the father's or husband's name and the village match a blocked person. Compare before you decide.

signals.family: Possibly the same family in this project: {name} ({benNo}) — {rule}

rule.union_village_father: same union, village and father's or husband's name

score.title: Score
score.help: The score only helps the decision; it never approves or rejects anyone by itself.

pull.title: Bring in the next
pull.help: The highest score on the waitlist is approved; on a tie, the one who has waited longest.

verify.profile: The profile it will be linked to
verify.name: Name
verify.blocked: This person is blocklisted. The entry can only be refused.
verify.create_help: A new profile is made from the entry's answers.
verify.owner_help: Without one the application stays the office's; a transfer can give it a volunteer later.
verify.title: Verify the entry
verify.create_other_help: If this is someone else, a new profile is made from the entry. If it is the same person, refuse the entry.

unlock.opened: The answer is open for correction.
unlock.volunteer_help: The office opened these answers for correction. Give the correct answer and send it; the office will verify it.
unlock.sent: The new answer is sent and waits for verification.
unlock.refused: The new answer is sent back; the previous answer stays.
unlock.cancelled: The unlock is cancelled; the previous answer stays.
unlock.own_entry: You entered the new answer, so another official verifies it.
unlock.volunteer_fills: The volunteer gives the new answer.

sync.saved_on_phone: Saved on this phone. It will go to the office when there is network.
sync.store_unavailable: Nothing can be kept on this phone right now, and there is no network. Try again when there is network.
sync.record_on_its_way: This record is on its way to the office; it can be removed once the office has answered.
